paper_goal: 面向约束旅游规划的大模型多 Agent 协作、调度与工具调用研究

main_benchmark.paper_label_zh: 开发后冻结的受控主基准
main_benchmark.purpose: 主实验用于比较四种方法在同一冻结数据、同一工具和同一评价器下的任务成功率、调度正确性与执行开销。

sealed_validation.purpose: 在系统、主基准、预算金标和统计方案冻结后，用于检查 M3 相对 M2 的结论是否在额外未调参案例上保持方向一致。
not_used_for: 替换 CTP100 主实验结论

statistical_plan.repeat_policy: 重复实验结果先按 case_id 聚合，不作为额外独立样本。
statistical_plan.minimum_claim_rule: 只有在 STSR/HCSR 不低于 M2 且效率指标下降时，才允许声称自适应调度在保持质量的同时降低开销。

runtime_controls.timeout_policy: Each case-method result is isolated in a subprocess during formal runs; a hung gateway call must produce a saved failed row instead of blocking the whole benchmark.
runtime_controls.provider_accounting_policy: LLM trace, manifest, smoke report, and price snapshot must derive provider from LLM_BASE_URL. VectorEngine must be recorded as vectorengine_openai_compatible.
runtime_controls.cost_accounting: Use provider-reported cost only when available; otherwise use frozen standardized token-cost estimates and mark actual_cost_status explicitly.
runtime_controls.failure_retention_policy: Timeouts, API failures, parse failures, and invalid structured outputs are retained as experimental evidence and must not be selectively deleted.

pre_formal_validation.warning_policy: Retry and internal provider-stability warnings are accepted only when transparently reported and when final rows have no failure, mock fallback, model fallback, or hard-timeout substitute.
pre_formal_validation.acceptance_policy: Before the full CTP100 run, execute a 20-case mixed-task four-method joint run to verify LLM stability, provider accounting, traces, latency, token/cost fields, timeout isolation, and evaluator calculability.

interpretation.raw_decision_success_rate: 模型原始 Agent 决策无需程序修复即可执行的比例。
interpretation.normalizer_recovery_rate: 模型原始 Agent 决策不规范、但被确定性归一化程序修复后可执行的比例。
interpretation.pipeline_completion_rate: case-method-turn 级结果最终完成的比例；该指标不等同于任务质量，只用于系统稳定性诊断。

decision_normalization.reporting_policy: 正式论文中作为诊断指标透明报告，不作为主要效果指标；M0/M1 若不存在多 Agent 决策，则 agent_decision_total 为 0，决策率记为 null，但仍统计 pipeline_completion_rate。
